checks.title: Conversion duong lam balance tang dung bang Conversion.amount
checks.precondition: Affiliate co balance ban dau da biet (vd $0); mot Conversion moi (tu import CSV hoac custom conversion entry) sap duoc tao voi amount > 0.
steps: Ghi lai User.balance hien tai cua affiliate.
Tao 1 Conversion moi voi amount duong (vd $20) gan cho affiliate do.
Doc lai User.balance ngay sau khi Conversion duoc tao.
checks.observation_point: User.balance (DB) ngay sau khi Conversion duoc ghi nhan.
checks.expected_result: User.balance moi = User.balance cu + Conversion.amount, cong ngay lap tuc (khong co delay/batch).

open_question_draft.summary: Oracle STRONG cua check 'CHK-001' hien chi dua tren KB item nguon dev_doc (toan bo KB cua run nay khong co spec_doc/po_dev_confirm/test_case nao).

checks.title: Conversion am (clawback/refund) lam balance giam dung gia tri tuyet doi
checks.precondition: Affiliate co balance du lon hon gia tri clawback sap tao (de tranh dung vao cau hoi 'balance co am duoc khong' - xem CHK-007).
steps: Ghi lai User.balance hien tai.
Tao 1 Conversion voi amount am (vd -$5, dong clawback/refund).
Doc lai User.balance ngay sau do.
checks.observation_point: User.balance (DB) ngay sau khi Conversion am duoc ghi nhan.

checks.title: getAllTimeCommissionAttribute = balance + tong Invoice.amount (completed/pending/approved)
checks.precondition: Affiliate co it nhat 1 Invoice o moi trang thai completed, pending, approved va 1 Invoice o trang thai cancel (de xac nhan cancel KHONG duoc tinh vao).
steps: Ghi lai User.balance hien tai.
Ghi lai tong Invoice.amount cua cac Invoice co status in (completed, pending, approved).
Doc gia tri getAllTimeCommissionAttribute (hoac field tuong duong hien thi cho affiliate).
checks.observation_point: Gia tri tra ve cua getAllTimeCommissionAttribute.
checks.expected_result: getAllTimeCommissionAttribute = balance + tong Invoice.amount cua cac invoice completed/pending/approved; Invoice o trang thai cancel KHONG duoc tinh vao tong.

checks.title: balance la so tich luy doc lap - khong duoc tinh lai tu tong Conversion.amount
checks.precondition: Affiliate da trai qua nhieu su kien nghiep vu khac nhau: >=2 Conversion, 1 lan tao Invoice (tru balance), 1 lan huy Invoice tu pending (hoan balance).
steps: Thuc hien tuan tu: Conversion #1 (+$30), Conversion #2 (+$10), tao Invoice amount=$15 (status pending), huy Invoice do (status cancel).
Sau moi buoc, ghi lai User.balance.
Tinh tong Conversion.amount doc lap (khong tinh Invoice) va so sanh voi balance cuoi cung.
checks.observation_point: User.balance sau tung buoc, so sanh voi tong Conversion.amount don thuan.
checks.expected_result: balance cuoi cung = $40 (tong 2 Conversion, vi Invoice da bi huy tu pending nen hoan lai dung $15) - balance phan anh chuoi su kien (cong/tru qua tung buoc), KHONG the suy ra chi tu 1 cong thuc 'tong Conversion.amount' don le vi no con bi anh huong boi Invoice.

checks.title: Nhieu Conversion tu nhieu ky Payout (Shopify) khac nhau cong don vao 1 balance truoc khi rut
checks.precondition: Co >=2 Conversion duoc tao tu 2 'ky Payout' Shopify khac nhau (mo phong bang 2 batch import CSV khac nhau, vd 2 ngay khac nhau), cung gan cho 1 affiliate.
steps: Import Conversion batch 1 (vd tu Payout ky 1) voi amount $20.
Import Conversion batch 2 (vd tu Payout ky 2, ngay khac) voi amount $25.
Doc User.balance sau ca 2 batch.
checks.observation_point: User.balance sau khi 2 Conversion tu 2 ky Payout khac nhau da duoc ghi nhan.
checks.expected_result: balance = $45 (cong don ca 2), khong co rang buoc 1-1 nao giua tung dong Payout va 1 Invoice/balance rieng - moi Conversion deu cong don vao cung 1 balance chung.

checks.title: [CAN XAC NHAN] Bonus 'premium offer' cong vao balance cho affiliate moi, va bi tru lai neu bonus bi thu hoi
checks.precondition: Affiliate moi du dieu kien nhan bonus 'premium offer' (dieu kien chinh xac chua duoc tai lieu hoa).
steps: Tao affiliate moi va kich hoat dieu kien nhan 'premium offer' (can PO/dev xac nhan dieu kien kich hoat cu the).
Doc User.balance truoc va sau khi bonus duoc cap.
Thu hoi bonus (neu co co che) va doc lai User.balance.
checks.observation_point: User.balance truoc/sau khi cap bonus va truoc/sau khi thu hoi.
checks.expected_result: KHONG CO expected_result duoc khang dinh - day la claim hedged, chi co trong tai lieu nhu 1 mo ta chua xac nhan. Can PO/dev xac nhan: (1) co che kich hoat bonus la gi, (2) bonus co thuc su cong/tru balance hay khong, (3) dieu kien thu hoi.

open_question_draft.summary: Co che bonus 'premium offer' cong/tru balance cho affiliate moi (KB-002) co phai hanh vi thuc da duoc xac nhan hay chi la mo ta hedged chua chac chan trong tai lieu dev?
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: Neu khong xac nhan, QA khong nen dung test case khang dinh/phu dinh hanh vi nay nhu 1 rule chinh thuc; can PO/dev xac nhan dieu kien kich hoat va co che cong/tru cu the truoc khi dung lam oracle.

checks.title: [CAN XAC NHAN] Balance co duoc phep am khong khi clawback lon hon so du hien co
checks.precondition: Affiliate co balance nho (vd $5); mot Conversion am (clawback) lon hon balance hien co (vd -$20) sap duoc tao.
steps: Ghi lai User.balance hien tai (vd $5).
Tao 1 Conversion am co |amount| > balance hien tai (vd -$20).
Doc lai User.balance sau do va kiem tra co loi/canh bao nao khong.
checks.observation_point: Gia tri User.balance sau clawback vuot qua so du, va bat ky error/validation message.
checks.expected_result: KHONG CO expected_result duoc khang dinh - khong co KB nao neu san; day la gap hoan toan (khong phai claim hedged, ma la khoang trong tai lieu). Can PO/dev xac nhan: balance duoc phep am, hay bi chan o 0 (floor), hay co co che khac (vd ghi no rieng).

open_question_draft.summary: Balance co duoc phep am khong khi mot Conversion clawback/refund co |amount| lon hon so du hien co cua affiliate?
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: Day la bien tien quan trong (gioi han so du); khong co expected result thi khong the viet test case bien cho truong hop nay, va rui ro tinh toan sai neu he thong cho phep am ngoai y muon.

checks.title: [CAN XAC NHAN] Co ledger/log doi soat tung lan balance tang/giam khong
checks.precondition: Affiliate da trai qua nhieu su kien lam thay doi balance (Conversion, tao/huy Invoice).
steps: Thuc hien 1 chuoi su kien lam balance thay doi nhieu lan.
Tim kiem trong portal/admin panel/DB mot bang ghi lai lich su tung lan thay doi balance (vd balance_ledger, balance_history...).
Neu ton tai, so sanh tong cac dong ghi voi delta balance thuc te.
checks.observation_point: Co hay khong mot nguon du lieu lich su rieng cho balance, ngoai gia tri User.balance hien tai.
checks.expected_result: KHONG CO expected_result duoc khang dinh - tai lieu khong neu ro co ledger hay khong. Can PO/dev xac nhan co ton tai co che doi soat nay hay chi verify duoc delta tuc thoi.

open_question_draft.summary: He thong co luu lai log/ledger cho tung lan balance tang/giam (de doi soat) hay chi co 1 gia tri User.balance hien tai duy nhat?
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: balance duoc goi la 'con so tich luy doc lap'; neu khong co ledger thi QA chi verify duoc delta tuc thoi sau tung hanh dong, khong verify duoc tong hop qua thoi gian hay dieu tra sai lech.
